why: Mail scan, Monday 19:00 Jakarta: Campus France Jakarta auto-reply

notes.itemTitle: Submit the visa application at TLS Contact
notes.title: Jakarta office is backed up
notes.text: Campus France Jakarta auto-replied to your follow-up: they are short-handed through the application season and expect normal service back on 16 November. They are the office that has to send the dossier once Delhi confirms, and you fly on 4 November. - Pressing Delhi is the lever you have left.
